content.text: {"answer":"The alternate site is a dedicated work-area recovery suite of 12 seats operated by Halvern Recovery Services, LLC in Bloomington, Minnesota, contracted for the Firm's exclusive use upon declaration and available for occupancy within four hours of the Firm's notice of declaration. Each seat has a workstation configured to the Firm's standard image, dual monitors and telephone service capable of receiving forwarded calls from the Firm's main line.","source_document":"04_business_continuity_plan.md","section":"SECTION 3. ALTERNATE SITE AND REMOTE OPERATIONS > 3.1 Alternate Site","quote":"The Firm's alternate site is a dedicated work-area recovery suite of 12 seats operated by Halvern Recovery Services, LLC in Bloomington, Minnesota. The suite is contracted for the Firm's exclusive use upon declaration and is available for occupancy within four hours of the Firm's notice of declaration. Each seat is equipped with a workstation configured to the Firm's standard image, dual monitors and telephone service capable of receiving forwarded calls from the Firm's main line."}
